title: Worker re-prompts each get a full harness bound, so a nudged worker can run ~2x TICKS_WORKER_TIMEOUT
description:
image/worker.sh nudge_due (715-727) refuses a nudge only once the time since the first start has reached harness_timeout. Each nudge then runs under a fresh `timeout $harness_timeout` (823-824) and a fresh omp --max-time. A first run that exits 0 with no report at 0.9T can therefore run to about 1.9T, past the dispatcher bound the variable exists to stay under, and a killed container pushes nothing. This is latent while no caller sets harness_budget_ms. Pass the remaining budget to each nudge, and test a nudge combined with a bound.
